stem: Which sentence best describes the relationship between Ben and Shruti?

options.label: A
options.text: Shruti and Ben are close friends who work on the same team.

options.label: B
options.text: Ben enjoys working alone, and so he tries to avoid Shruti.

options.label: C
options.text: Shruti wants to befriend Ben, but Ben is often too busy to notice.

options.label: D
options.text: Shruti and Ben challenge each other to improve their grades at school.
